newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrower.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat, price spread narrower.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed virtually unchanged at 476.25/476.60 per dollar Friday, compared to 466.25/466.75 Thursday, as increased competition between banks saw the margin between bid and offer prices shrink further, traders said.
"There was hardly any demand (for foreign currency) and a bit of supply. The market in general is very quiet," one broker said.
Traders added that the continued rise in foreign reserves thanks to strong oil export prices had reduced the amount of speculative currency demand.
"With more reserves the Central Bank has greater ability to maintain the exchange rate and meet all requirements," one trader said.
